headline: Director Engineering & AI | Transforming Lifesciences with AI
about:
Vatsal is a seasoned professional in the technology industry, currently serving as a Director with PwC. With a strong focus on product development, cloud engineering, and digital transformations in the healthcare and life-sciences sector, Vatsal brings a wealth of expertise to his role.

As a certified Solutions Architect, Vatsal has garnered recognition for his in-depth knowledge of cloud native architectures and well-architected platforms on AWS. Throughout his career, he has assumed various roles such as cloud architect, product owner,  prototyping specialist and software engineer. His broad experience allows him to guide clients effectively on their digital transformation journey, helping them establish a solid foundation for their cloud initiatives.

Vatsal's passion lies in platform builds that leverage automation and AI and he finds great joy in witnessing his prototypes scale up and come to life. With a keen eye for detail and a commitment to excellence, he continuously strives to deliver innovative solutions that drive business success in the ever-evolving technology landscape.

experience.description:
As a Director at PwC, I lead AI and cloud engineering initiatives focused on the healthcare and life sciences sectors. I specialize in building scalable, compliant AI platforms and intelligent automation solutions that drive digital transformation across pharmacovigilance, clinical trials, and manufacturing quality systems.

I’ve led the architecture and delivery of industry-first platforms — including a AI-powered Quality Management System (QMS) that automates complaint and deviation management, and an AI-driven pharmacovigilance solution that reduces case processing time by over 90%. I’ve also built reusable cloud-native applications and MLOps pipelines enabling faster, more secure deployments for global pharma clients.

My role spans product strategy, solution design, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration — all with a strong focus on regulated environments and enterprise-scale delivery

experience.position: Principal (Partner), Customer Experience, Marketing & Insights Practice
experience.description:
PwC is a global leader in professional services. Within our Trust Solutions and Consulting Solutions segments, PwC brings a range of capabilities to help organizations solve faster, solve more and realize more value. These capabilities include digital experience design, sales and marketing, cloud and digital, deals, ESG, cybersecurity and privacy, governance/boards, risk, transformation, tax services and more.

As a Partner, I lead of PwC's Chicago Customer Experience & Insights Practice and service a portfolio of client accounts. Our Customer Experience Practice works to research consumer needs, craft digital strategies, design and build user experiences, and implement technologies which bring branded experiences to life.

SapientRazorfish, a division of Publicis Groupe, is one of the world's largest digital marketing agencies providing services including marketing and business strategy, technology and innovation, web development, analytics & data, mobile, media planning and buying, advertising, creative, social influence marketing and search.

As a Managing Partner, I was responsible for a portfolio encompassing 11 major accounts and greater than $48M in annual (service fee) revenue
- Over my tenure at SapientRazorfish, I grew my portfolio revenue nearly 400% with sizable wins including ALDI, Caterpillar, Eaton, Esurance and Simon Properties Group
- I was responsible and accountable for SapientRazorfish's overarching client satisfaction by establishing and maintaining C-level and senior-level client relationships

publications.title: Hmong Shua: A Dying Language amongst the Living
publications.publishedAt: New Plains Review/University of Central Oklahoma · Mar 2, 2015
publications.description: Our world is one of high linguistic diversity, yet as cultures and language norms begin to socially dominate many languages begin to weaken to stronger, generally economically and educationally backed, languages. There are over 3,000 endangered languages in the world and one of particular regional interest is that of the Hmong people. They are a culturally separated indigenous subgroup rooted from the Miao Chinese ethnic minority that have no national home. They have large populations in China, Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, Burma, and the United States. As an ethnic minority they have grown tremendously in the last half century, but a particular Hmong dialect that has become endangered in recent years is the southern Chinese dialect Hmong Shua (this is one of five endangered or seriously threatened Hmong dialects). The particular issues in focus are the historical and comparative nature of the growing Hmong populace, and the surprisingly antithetical decline of the Chinese dialectical form.

publications.title: Brontian Pastiche in Post-suffrage South Riding
publications.description: Pastiche has become an increasingly popular way of developing relevant, contemporary works of literature that fit within the presentation of universally understandable concepts and individuals, and especially to those who have read the original work that is being adapted. Charlotte Brontë’s Jane Eyre is a particularly well-known part of the literary canon, and has been continually reproduced and recreated; though, many of these recreations are set in the period that Jane Eyre was written, both in literary and media forms, with very little attached literary commentary of different time periods. Pastiche is unique in that it has a basis in a previous work without being a direct adaptation, and tends to include dissimilar environmental factors to the original work. The novel, South Riding, by Winifred Holtby is a particularly intriguing pastiche on Jane Eyre as a feminist novel set in a post-suffrage environment. There are shared concepts of masculine dominance (particularly focused on rape (or the threat thereof)), matriarchal power structures in education, and strong female characters and their social roles as women. These aspects create a new but familiar pretense by which one may analyze transformations in English society, and the role feminism has in altering the society’s and the novel’s structure. This Post-suffrage concept adaptation has yet to be directly discussed in the realm of publication concerning South Riding. This form of pastiche allows the academic import of post-suffrage feminism to be more readily compared with the aspects of pre-suffrage feminism in Jane Eyre in a way that is relatable to both readers of original literary classic and the more contemporary audiences.

about:
Ed is a highly experienced industry professional providing proactive business and tax consulting services to asset managers globally. His clients include hedge funds, credit funds, fund-of-funds, family offices, and private equity funds. Driven to build and maintain long-term, mutually beneficial relationships, Ed focuses intensely on his clients’ needs, offering consultation on structuring, financial products, and business issues they encounter throughout the year.

Ed continually adds value to his relationships, providing thoughtful and creative leadership and direction to his clients and engagement teams. Where appropriate, Ed participates on various governance committees for his clients. He holds an advanced degree in taxation and is a Certified Public Accountant. Additionally, Ed regularly participates in executive education classes on leadership and innovation.

Active in his community, Ed has served as a member of the Chicago American Heart Association’s Executive Leadership Team and the Board of Directors for Midwest Young Artists Conservatory, CASA of Cook County, and Bridge Communities. He is also a retired long-time member of the Midwest Hedge Funds Care board and a former director of the Hedge Fund Association's Midwest chapter.

headline: Senior Treasury Management & Payments Leader | Driving Strategic Transformation Across Commercial Banking, Enterprise Businesses & Payment Companies
topSkills: Payments • Leadership • Treasury Management • New Business Development • Financial Services
about:
Senior payments leader with more than 18 years of experience in payments, treasury, financial operations, and commercial banking. I help financial institutions, fintech companies, and enterprise clients modernize their payment environments and build scalable, controlled, and efficient financial operations.

My work focuses on payment optimization, funds flow design, reconciliation modernization, exception management, cash positioning, and overall treasury operations. I specialize in simplifying complex payment ecosystems, improving controls, reducing operational cost, and creating future state models that support growth, transparency, and risk reduction.

I have led large scale transformation programs for banks, fintechs, global processors, and enterprise clients. This includes redesigning payment flows, strengthening reconciliation and reporting processes, improving cash and settlement operations, and defining governance models that help organizations operate more efficiently. I focus on practical, hands on delivery and I partner closely with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Product leaders to drive measurable results.

I am known for a collaborative approach and a strong ability to connect strategy to execution. I enjoy coaching teams, solving complex operational challenges, and helping clients create payment and treasury environments that improve accuracy, speed, and client experience.

Outside of work, I am committed to supporting nonprofit organizations and advancing equity and inclusion within the financial services industry.

Core strengths include strategic leadership, financial operations, payments expertise, problem solving, client engagement, cross functional collaboration, structured delivery, and clear communication.

experience.position: Senior Manager, FS Transformation Commercial Payments
experience.description:
As a Senior Manager in the Banking Transformation Payments team, I lead strategic consulting engagements that help financial institutions, enterprise businesses, and payment companies modernize their payment capabilities and optimize Treasury Management operations. With over 15 years of experience in commercial banking, I bring deep expertise across the Treasury Management value chain including product development, onboarding, servicing, sales, billing, and governance.

My focus is on delivering scalable, efficient, and client-centric solutions that align with business goals, reduce operational risk, and enhance overall performance. I combine a practical, insight-driven approach with hands-on execution to drive meaningful transformation.

Types of engagements I lead include:
-End-to-end transformation of billing, collection, and payment processes for large enterprises
-Optimization of reporting and reconciliation workflows for global payment processors, including data mapping and control design
-Current and future state assessments for regional banks, including the design of target operating models and enhanced servicing strategies
-Redesign of client onboarding processes to support scalability, efficiency, and compliance
-Development of client servicing segmentation models to enable high-touch service with existing resources
-Creation of governance frameworks that include SteerCo structures, performance metrics, training plans, and revised operational procedures

I work closely with client leadership and cross-functional teams to define strategy and execute change. I am passionate about delivering long-term value, mentoring peers, and supporting community and nonprofit efforts while promoting equity and inclusion in the workplace.

As an Advisory Manager within the Bank Transformation-Transaction Banking group, provides support and leadership with client engagements that require functional and technical expertise in areas of commercial/wholesale banking, treasury management and payments, client onboarding, product implementation and end-client servicing.  Advises banks and fintechs on current state enhancements and future state operating model backed by industry best practices, data driven insight, and firm experience. Serves as a subject matter expert in payments and TM across various practices and teams.

• Oversees daily Treasury Service activities of all Operations staff to ensure all requests and inquiries are completed in accordance with Acrisure's standard operating procedures. 
• Provides Operations support of ongoing requests and inquiries from home office and agency partners. 
• Monitors centralized disbursement activity (ACH, Wire, Check) for all Home Office-managed payables and disbursements.
• Works closely with home office teams including agency accounting, corporate accounting, M&A, finance and other home office teams on Treasury related items.
• Administer positive pay file transmissions, exceptions, and required actions
• Develop best practices for daily operations workflow requests from internal and external parties
• Serves as a primary bank administrator to manage and maintain bank portal entitlements, services, and controls. 
• Provides internal training to key stakeholders related to best practices for secure payments and fraud prevention
• Supports training and education to internal and Agency Partners of Treasury products and services.
• Supports broader treasury team initiatives related to payments and process efficiency.
• Monitors and maintains Corporate cash position and cash forecasting activities.
• Assists as needed with M&A on-boarding activities for agency partner banking transitions including new account openings, signatory changes, and bank product training.
• Identifies and drives process efficiencies related to assigned activities.

Acrisure is the fastest growing insurance brokerage firm in the U.S. with nearly 450 Agency Partner locations globally. We are a committed network of entrepreneurs dedicated to providing specialty insurance programs, risk management services and unique products for an ever-growing market. Our team is comprised of innovative, talented individuals who are the driving force of the success we have experienced and continue to achieve in this fast-paced industry.
